newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bourse seen rising, all eyes on Amsterdam.
newsitem.headline: French bourse seen rising, all eyes on Amsterdam.

text.p: French stocks were expected to rise to new heights on Monday, fuelled by expectations that European leaders will reach a compromise in Amsterdam on the stability pact to enforce fiscal discipline after the launch of a single European currency.
Bonds were higher and the dollar was steady. Wall Street registered a sixth consecutive closing record on Friday.
* CAC-40 June futures contract traded on GLOBEX up 29 points at 2,822
* CAC-40 index finished up 48.25 points, or 1.75 percent, at record closing high of 2,808.52 on Friday
